verdicts.reason: Both have the same layout failure. The headline 'Award-Winning Architecture' has been pulled out of its dark panel and floats as small, low-contrast gold text in a thin box on white near the top, while the dark panel is left as a large empty slab that covers most of the pattern band. The pattern itself is cut off as a strip, with large dead white areas above and below it, so this is not a deliberate portrait layout. The only difference is that B's empty panel is slightly larger and closer to the edges, which doesn't make it meaningfully better or worse.
